label: Google Sheets: Lookup Rows
description: Finds the rows of a Google Sheets tab whose given header column holds an exact value (resolve an id to its record, check a key is already logged); emits the rows, their row numbers, and whether any matched.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The picker grant covers the file it picked.

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=
inputs.description: The tab to use. Empty: the first tab, whatever its id.

inputs.name: column
inputs.label: Column
inputs.description: Header column to match on (a header row is required).

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: Matching rows, keyed by the header.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Whether at least one row matched.
